def get_packages(files: Optional[List[str]]=None, stdin: bool=False) ->List[
    Package]:
    packages = []
    
    if stdin:
        content = sys.stdin.read()
        if content.strip():
            requirements = read_requirements(content, filename='<stdin>')
            packages.extend(Package(name=req.name, version=req.specifier) for req in requirements)
    
    if files:
        for file_path in files:
            try:
                with open(file_path, 'r') as f:
                    content = f.read()
                    if content.strip():
                        requirements = read_requirements(content, filename=file_path)
                        packages.extend(Package(name=req.name, version=req.specifier) for req in requirements)
            except FileNotFoundError:
                # Handle file not found gracefully
                pass
            except Exception:
                # Handle other file reading errors
                pass
    
    return packages
